name: Collateral Substitution 7
definition: Provides details about the collateral that will be substituted.

CollateralSubstitutionSequence.name: Collateral Substitution Sequence
CollateralSubstitutionSequence.definition: Indicates whether the collateral substitution request is new or updated.

SubstitutionRequirement.name: Substitution Requirement
SubstitutionRequirement.definition: Cash value of the requested collateral substitution transfer in the base currency.

CollateralSubstitutionType.name: Collateral Substitution Type
CollateralSubstitutionType.definition: Specifies if the collateral that is substituted was posted against the variation margin or the independent amount.

OtherCollateral.name: Other Collateral
OtherCollateral.definition: Collateral type is other than securities or cash for example letter of credit.

LinkedReferences.name: Linked References
LinkedReferences.definition: Provides details on the identification of previously sent and/or received message(s), in case of updated substitution request.

SubstitutionRequestSequenceRule.definition: If CollateralSubstitutionRequestSequence equals "Updated" (UPDD) then LinkedReferences must be present.
